title: Playbook Plugin Manifest (Plugin Contract v1)
description: Serializable descriptor of a Playbook plugin: the identity and declared surface the loader validates before a plugin is registered. Executable members (rule check/matchesFailure/fix, detector detect) are functions and are validated structurally by the loader, not by this schema. See docs/contracts/PLUGIN_CONTRACT_V1.md.

contractVersion.description: Absent means 1. Any other value makes the loader skip the plugin with a notice.

pluginSpecifier.description: A playbook.config.json `plugins` entry: a package name (optionally scoped, optional sub-path) or a ./ path whose real path stays inside the repository. Absolute paths, drive paths, backslashes, `..` segments, URL schemes and Node built-ins are rejected before anything is resolved.
